tab-min-width.$description: The narrowest a tab gets, so a short name such as "a.ts" still has room for its icon and the close button beside it instead of shrinking to the label alone.

tab-max-width.$description: The widest a tab grows. A longer name is cut with an ellipsis rather than letting one tab take the strip; the full name is on the tab's title and in the tab list menu.
